name: LSM6DS33 accelerometer & gyroscope
description: STMicroelectronics 6-axis IMU: 3-axis accelerometer (±2/4/8/16 g) and 3-axis gyroscope (±125–2000 dps) plus a die temperature sensor, read over I2C (or SPI). The chip runs on 1.71–3.6 V; the carrier adds a 3.3 V regulator and SDA/SCL level shifters for 2.5–5.5 V. Sold as: Pololu LSM6DS33 3D Accelerometer and Gyro Carrier with Voltage Regulator (#2736), one 9-pin header VDD, VIN, GND, SDA, SCL, SDO, CS, INT2, INT1, I2C address 0x6B (0x6A with SDO/SA0 tied to GND), 10 kΩ I2C pull-ups to VIN.
eli5: Feels which way it is tilted and how fast it is spinning, so your project knows how it is moving.

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: Regulated 3.3 V output of the on-board regulator (about 150 mA spare); can instead be a 3.3 V input with VIN unconnected. Leave unconnected

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply, 2.5–5.5 V (on-board 3.3 V regulator feeds the chip; SDA/SCL are pulled up to this voltage, so use your board's logic voltage)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (SPI SDI); level-shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN on the board

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C / SPI clock; level-shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN on the board

pins.name: SDO
pins.description: SDO/SA0: I2C address bit, 10 kΩ pull-up to VDD = 0x6B, tie to GND for 0x6A; SPI data out (3.3 V, not level-shifted). Leave unconnected for I2C

pins.name: CS
pins.description: Interface select: 10 kΩ pull-up to VDD = I2C mode; drive low only for SPI (3.3 V, not 5 V tolerant). Leave unconnected

pins.name: INT2
pins.description: Programmable interrupt 2 output (3.3 V push-pull, not level-shifted), optional

pins.name: INT1
pins.description: Programmable interrupt 1 output (3.3 V push-pull, not level-shifted), optional

buildNotes: Power VIN from your board's logic voltage (3.3 V on ESP32/Pico): the SDA/SCL level shifters pull the bus up to VIN through 10 kΩ, so VIN = 5 V would put 5 V on a 3.3 V board's pins.
Leave VDD unconnected (it is the regulator's 3.3 V output). Leave CS unconnected (pulled up = I2C) and SDO unconnected (pulled up = address 0x6B).
SDO, CS, INT1 and INT2 are not level-shifted and are not 5 V tolerant.

Check WHO_AM_I (register 0x0F) reads 0x69; then write CTRL3_C = 0x44 (BDU + auto-increment), CTRL1_XL = 0x40 (104 Hz, ±2 g) and CTRL2_G = 0x40 (104 Hz, ±245 dps). Both sensors are powered down until you do.
Outputs are 16-bit two's complement, low byte first: accel 0x28–0x2D (0.061 mg/LSB at ±2 g), gyro 0x22–0x27 (8.75 mdps/LSB at ±245 dps), temperature 0x20–0x21 (25 °C + raw/16).

driver.code:
# LSM6DS33 accelerometer + gyroscope (STMicroelectronics, DocID027423), MicroPython driver.
# Register map from the datasheet: WHO_AM_I 0x0F = 0x69, CTRL1_XL 0x10, CTRL2_G 0x11, CTRL3_C 0x12
# (default 0x04: IF_INC set), STATUS_REG 0x1E, OUT_TEMP 0x20-0x21, OUTX_L_G 0x22-0x27,
# OUTX_L_XL 0x28-0x2D (16-bit two's complement, low byte first).
# Temperature: 16 LSB/degC, 0 LSB = 25 degC (typ.).
import time

_WHO_AM_I = 0x0F
_CTRL1_XL = 0x10
_CTRL2_G = 0x11
_CTRL3_C = 0x12
_STATUS = 0x1E
_OUT_TEMP_L = 0x20
_OUTX_L_G = 0x22
_OUTX_L_XL = 0x28

# Full scale -> (FS_XL bits for CTRL1_XL[3:2], sensitivity in g/LSB). FS_XL coding: 00 2 g, 01 16 g, 10 4 g, 11 8 g.
_ACC_FS = {2: (0b00, 0.061e-3), 4: (0b10, 0.122e-3), 8: (0b11, 0.244e-3), 16: (0b01, 0.488e-3)}
# Full scale -> (CTRL2_G[3:1] = FS_G1 FS_G0 FS_125, sensitivity in dps/LSB).
_GYR_FS = {125: (0b001, 4.375e-3), 245: (0b000, 8.75e-3), 500: (0b010, 17.5e-3),
           1000: (0b100, 35e-3), 2000: (0b110, 70e-3)}


def _s16(lo, hi):
    v = lo | (hi << 8)
    return v - 65536 if v & 0x8000 else v


class LSM6DS33:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x6B, accel_fs=2, gyro_fs=245):
        """addr: 0x6B with SDO/SA0 high (Pololu board default), 0x6A with SDO/SA0 tied to GND."""
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        time.sleep_ms(20)  # boot time after power-up
        who = self._r(_WHO_AM_I, 1)[0]
        if who != 0x69:
            raise OSError('LSM6DS33 not found at 0x%02X (WHO_AM_I=0x%02X)' % (addr, who))
        fa, self._acc_s = _ACC_FS[accel_fs]
        fg, self._gyr_s = _GYR_FS[gyro_fs]
        # BDU=1 (MSB and LSB from the same sample), IF_INC=1 (auto-increment for burst reads).
        self._w(_CTRL3_C, 0x44)
        # ODR 104 Hz high-performance (0100), chosen full scale, anti-aliasing BW 400 Hz (00).
        self._w(_CTRL1_XL, 0x40 | (fa << 2))
        # ODR 104 Hz (0100), chosen full scale; bit 0 must be 0.
        self._w(_CTRL2_G, 0x40 | (fg << 1))
        time.sleep_ms(100)  # let the gyroscope start up and the first samples arrive

    def _r(self, reg, n):
        return self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, reg, n)

    def _w(self, reg, val):
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, reg, bytes([val]))

    def _xyz(self, reg, scale):
        d = self._r(reg, 6)
        return (_s16(d[0], d[1]) * scale, _s16(d[2], d[3]) * scale, _s16(d[4], d[5]) * scale)

    def data_ready(self):
        """(accel, gyro, temperature) new-data flags from STATUS_REG."""
        s = self._r(_STATUS, 1)[0]
        return bool(s & 1), bool(s & 2), bool(s & 4)

    def acceleration(self):
        """(x, y, z) in g."""
        return self._xyz(_OUTX_L_XL, self._acc_s)

    def gyro(self):
        """(x, y, z) angular rate in degrees per second."""
        return self._xyz(_OUTX_L_G, self._gyr_s)

    def temperature(self):
        """Die temperature in degC (offset up to +/-15 degC, not an air thermometer)."""
        d = self._r(_OUT_TEMP_L, 2)
        return 25 + _s16(d[0], d[1]) / 16

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from lsm6ds33 import LSM6DS33

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
imu = LSM6DS33(i2c)  # 0x6B: Pololu board default (SDO/SA0 pulled up)
while True:
    ax, ay, az = imu.acceleration()
    gx, gy, gz = imu.gyro()
    t = imu.temperature()
    print('A=%.2f,%.2f,%.2fg G=%.1f,%.1f,%.1fdps T=%.1fC' % (ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz, t))
    time.sleep(1)
